correctness.rationale: For every cut the transition entries are exactly (a+b-1)/d, (a+b)/d and a/c. The explicit cut formula is convex in b; the competing target is a concave quadratic with endpoint deficits a(c-a)(s-1)/d and exact chord surplus sb(s-b)/d. The resulting sharp binary inequality extends to all real signals by the exact nested-level-set Gini decomposition and triangle inequality. The class-contrast vector is a quotient eigenvector with eigenvalue -s/d, yielding sharp norm of every integer power; full equality classification and special cases are proved. The packaged rational checker independently constructs matrices and tests 7618 cuts, 1183 exact eigenmode attainments and 12100 rational inputs; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The natural unweighted complete-pair variation of a standard degree-normalized Markov averaging operator admits a complete closed-form all-power stability law and two separately optimal within-community losses. Sharp classwise extremizer rigidity and the exact c=1 versus c>=2 contraction boundary characterize repeated averaging on a family with strong degree heterogeneity. The classwise deficit is not a mere presentation of the usual spectral gap or generic ergodicity-coefficient definition; it quantitatively detects within-part oscillation.
